examples.name: Read one barcode back
examples.description: Reads a barcode for a merchant. The expiration date is date-only, and metadata is returned as a JSON string of key/value pairs.
examples.query:
query Barcode($merchant_uid: ID!, $barcode_id: String!) {
  barcode(merchant_uid: $merchant_uid, barcode_id: $barcode_id) {
    barcode_id
    barcode_url
    merchant_uid
    amount
    fees
    expiration_date
    full_name
    email_or_phone
    sale_id
    reference
    account_code
    invoice_id
    metadata
  }
}

examples.name: Create a barcode
examples.description: Creates a barcode a payor can use to make a cash payment.
examples.query:
mutation CreateBarcode($input: BarcodeInput!) {
  createBarcode(input: $input) {
    barcode_id
    barcode_url
    merchant_uid
    amount
    fees
    expiration_date
    full_name
    email_or_phone
    sale_id
    reference
    account_code
  }
}
